title: Great habit tracker
body: Love the app, I've used and tried most of the habit trackers on the App Store but this is what I keep coming back to. It's the most lightweight and fast app of this kind you'll find. The UI is simple and "professional" so if you are looking for something with a more playful vibe you might need to look elsewhere. Never experienced a crash or anything of the sort, so the app is rock solid, and the Apple Watch complication is also very dependable. Pricing is on the higher side for this kind of apps, with 30 euros for a yearly premium subscription. There are other apps that are almost as good, with 10 euros per year or 30 eu as a one off purchase. Still, highly recommend this one.
author: git-m

title: Nice clean and do the job
body: Great app with simple and clean UI, using free version for now and cannot be more satisfied. App does not bother you every five minutes with paid upgrade or similar. Thanks for good work guys.
